A Letter For You 🥹

My love,

Long distance isn't always easy. I miss the little things—the hugs, sitting beside you, seeing your face whenever I want. But somehow, even from far away, you still manage to make my days softer and my heart happier.

Thank you for being my person, for every conversation, every laugh, every reassurance, and every little moment that reminds me that distance is only a distance.

One day, I want us to look back at these photos and smile because we finally made all those “I wish you were here” moments real. ❤️

Until then, keep choosing me. I'll keep choosing you. Always. 🫂❤️

💗

It's You.

No matter how many miles are between us, you're still my favourite person.

I love you. More than words can fit here. ❤️

— Your girl 🥹
